subject: Executive sponsor mapping + EB sync to finalize MAP and close timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Executive sponsor mapping + EB sync to finalize MAP and close timeline

Lisa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. To keep momentum toward the end-of-quarter close, I'd like to propose a short Exec Briefing (EB) to align on:

- Executive sponsor mapping (who will be the champion + backstop)
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones and deliverables
- Evaluation plan and success metrics we need from Acme to complete the POC/acceptance
- Procurement timeline to finalize T&Cs and get to PO

Can you confirm the exec sponsor(s) you expect to have on the EB? Suggested slots: Wed Nov 3 (preferred) or Fri Oct 29 (if leadership availability is limited). We anticipate 25–30 minutes.

I attached a one-page MAP template to speed capture — please populate the sponsor and milestone rows if convenient. If procurement prefers a separate thread, forward me their contact and I’ll include them.

Next steps from our side: Marissa will run the EB agenda and Aditya will draft the evaluation checklist and metrics table.

Thanks,
Sergio
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Acme-MAP-template.xlsx (stub, 22 KB)
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor mapping + EB sync to finalize MAP and close timeline

Sergio —

Appreciate the follow-up. Confirming: I (Lisa Chen, CPO) will be the exec sponsor and I will bring procurement (copied) for the commercial questions. Procurement's preliminary timeline is attached.

We filled out the MAP template with key milestones and a proposed cutover window — see attached "Acme-MAP-completed.xlsx". We can do a quick EB on Fri Oct 29 at 11:00am PDT if that helps accelerate. If we need the C-suite to unblock, Wed Nov 3 is also possible but later in the week is tougher for my schedule.

Also attaching a short procurement timeline PDF so your finance/legal teams can pre-review.

Lisa
Lisa Chen
Chief Product Officer, Acme Corp
Attachment: Acme-MAP-completed.xlsx (stub, 48 KB)
Attachment: procurement-timeline.pdf (stub, 14 KB)

Great — thanks for confirming, Lisa. Fri Oct 29 at 11:00am PDT works from our side if that gets us in front of the right stakeholders sooner.

A couple quick asks to make the EB productive:
- Marissa: can you draft a 25–30 minute agenda that includes a 5–7 minute ask for the exec sponsor (decision/commitment) and a clear runbook for next 30/60/90 days?
- Aditya: please prepare the evaluation checklist (acceptance criteria + required data) and a short slide on performance/cost expectations so leadership can sign off.
- Lisa / procurement: if you have any mandatory contract must-haves (data residency, minimum SLA terms) please flag them in the MAP so Legal/Finance can triage ahead of the EB.

I’ll calendar the EB tentatively for Oct 29 at 11am PDT and will send an invite once we lock the attendees.

Sergio

Looping internal owners —

Thanks, Sergio / Lisa. I’ll own the EB logistics and agenda. Draft agenda (25 min):

1) 0:00–0:05 — Introductions & sponsor ask (Lisa)
2) 0:05–0:12 — Brief recap of POC results / demo highlights (Sergio)
3) 0:12–0:18 — Evaluation checklist & acceptance criteria (Aditya)
4) 0:18–0:22 — Commercial & procurement run-through (Sergio)
5) 0:22–0:25 — Next steps & confirmation of MAP milestones

Action items assigned:
- Marissa: send calendar invite + attach EB agenda and MAP to invite (will do once attendees confirmed).
- Aditya: populate evaluation metrics table and upload to the shared doc (assigning: demo performance, integration checkpoints, sample dataset availability).
- Sergio: capture sponsor ask and escalation path in the MAP.

Attachment: EB-agenda-draft.pdf (stub, 18 KB)

I’ll tentatively hold Oct 29 11:00am PDT on my calendar and update once Lisa confirms final attendees.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Acknowledged — I’ve started a shared evaluation doc and populated the first-pass metrics (latency targets, q50/q95, integration smoke tests, sample size for accuracy checks). Link below. I’ll add a short slide for EB that summarizes the pass/fail criteria and data we need from Acme.

Shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFGhIJkL-map-eval (view/comment)

I also added a note in the MAP about required telemetry retention and a recommended rollback plan in case we see regression during ramp.

Aditya
